source: USGS Mars 2020 TRN HiRISE orthomosaic, 25 cm (DOI 10.5066/P9REJ9JN), resampled by tools/data/bake_tiles.py with the same contrast stretch as jezero_base_2m.jpg
use: Sharper photo tiles for the 3D view, drawn over jezero_base_2m.jpg. Optional: the view works without them. Row 0 is the tile's north edge, column 0 its west edge.
frame: Same frame as jezero_pack.json: metres from the map's north-west corner, x east, y south.
